intentions.title: Ship one self-contained OTP release that boots and serves HTTP without depending on a host's Erlang/Elixir toolchain
intentions.evidence: api/mix.exs releases/0 sets include_erts: true and include_executables_for: [:unix]; rel/env.sh.eex defaults PHX_SERVER=true so `bin/barkpark start` just works; api/entrypoint.sh runs Barkpark.Release.migrate()/seed() then `bin/barkpark start` as the container's exec target.

intentions.title: Run production Phoenix as a systemd service that survives ASDF-managed Elixir installs and blue/green slot deploys
intentions.evidence: api/start.sh sources ASDF shims (systemd can't use them directly), loads ../.env, and honors BARKPARK_PORT_OVERRIDE so two blue/green slots (barkpark-slot@.service) can bind distinct ports while sharing one .env.

intentions.title: Make every prod deploy/restart self-verifying instead of trusting a green systemctl exit code
intentions.evidence: api/scripts/prod-postcheck.sh restarts the service if inactive, sleeps for BEAM boot, then curls /api/schemas and dumps `systemctl status` on failure — documented as a deliberate recovery guardrail, NOT a passive monitor.

intentions.title: Keep validation-engine throughput under a hard 100ms ceiling for a realistic 200-field/100-rule document, enforced automatically in CI
intentions.evidence: api/bench/validation_perf.exs runs Evaluator.run_rules 5x via `mix run --no-start` (no DB boot needed), computes min/median/max/mean, and System.halt(1)s when median exceeds @regression_alarm_ms (100ms, zero headroom by design); doc+rule fixtures inlined so the bench stays a single self-contained diff.

intentions.title: Keep the PortableDoc canvas editor and the public reader rendering pixel-identical output from one shared render path
intentions.evidence: api/scripts/pass2_audit_harness.exs is the sanctioned standalone static harness (mix phx.server dies locally, so this is the only sanctioned reader-render path) that calls the exact same Barkpark.PortableDoc.Render.render_block/2 the canvas uses, emits a per-block-type HTML+signature table, and fails only on a real render exception — built for the paper edit⇄reader parity audit (charter W1.4).

intentions.title: Provide one Phoenix macro factory so every controller/LiveView/component gets consistent routing, Gettext, and shared Studio helpers without hand-wiring imports
intentions.evidence: api/lib/barkpark_web.ex defines router/channel/controller/live_view/live_component/html quoted blocks sharing html_helpers (imports BarkparkWeb.StudioComponents, BarkparkWeb.Icons, Gettext) and verified_routes/0 binding BarkparkWeb.Endpoint/Router/static_paths — the `use BarkparkWeb, :thing` entrypoint for the whole web layer.

intentions.title: Let every optional capability (auth methods, image backend, plugin deps) be toggled per-environment without breaking a zero-friction native dev setup, especially on Windows
intentions.evidence: api/mix.exs image_dep/0 drops :image (libvips NIF has no Windows prebuilt binary) unless BARKPARK_WITH_IMAGE=1 forces it or BARKPARK_SKIP_IMAGE=1 forces it off, with ImageMagick CLI documented as the Windows fallback; deps comments tie SSO/SAML/WebAuthn/passkey libs (jose, esaml, x509, wax_) and Sheets (xlsx_reader, elixlsx) and the tmux console (expty) each to their owning epic/wave (era-w2-passkeys, era-w3-oidc-rp/saml, T5.1).
